newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover fell to 22,500 denars at Thursday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 133,300 denars at the previous session on Tuesday as only one company traded, the exchange said.
Ading Skopje made its debut on the third floor, selling nine stocks at 2,500 denars, well below par of 30,970 denars.
Traded volume was 43 shares on Tuesday.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
